title: Dockerfile builds an image with no non-root USER instruction
remediation:
Create an unprivileged account (`RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S app -G app` or
equivalent for the base distro) and add a `USER app` instruction before the container's default
entrypoint/cmd runs, so the process does not run as root by default. An attacker who achieves code
execution inside the container then does not automatically inherit root privileges in the
container's own namespace.

title: Base image not pinned to a content digest
remediation:
Pin the base image with an `@sha256:<digest>` suffix (`docker pull` and then
`docker inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}'` the image you intend to use, or read the
digest off the registry) in addition to, or instead of, a tag - a tag can be repointed at a
different image server-side, but a digest cannot.
